mechanism: Carisoprodol (CNS depressant) combined with amphetamine (CNS stimulant) creates opposing pharmacodynamic effects and increased risk of overdose, seizures, and cardiovascular stress; carisoprodol metabolizes to meprobamate which has abuse potential synergistic with amphetamine.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor closely for seizures, arrhythmias, altered mental status, and substance abuse; consider alternative muscle relaxants without abuse potential.
